claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says a reptilian invasion of Vega, Avalon, and Lyra triggered the Great Expansion, dispersing humanoids; Earth had eight women survivors, male count unknown.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She says Taygetans pursued invaders into this system, destroying Tiamat and devastating Mars with extensive nuclear weapons; she condemns Tiamat's destruction.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
claims.qualifiers: She says the destruction was unjustifiable and incurred species-level karma.

claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) calls the current Earth conflict a continuation of the Orion Wars and says the Federation now holds superiority over regressive reptiles.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
